track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 4: Naghmeh
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Naghmeh in Bayat-e Tork, Chahargah, Mahur, Nava, Rast-Panjgah, Segah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D3 and dwells most on A in Naghmeh. The line peaks at A4 (443.8 Hz) at 1:16.3. It closes on A2, not the tonic (E3 → A2 → A3 → A3 → Gb3 → A2).
